title: Grateful Dead Live at McGaw Memorial Hall, Northwestern U. on 1973-11-01
lineage: SBDMR> Cass> DAT> CDR> EAC> Soundforge> DePopper> SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a second‑set gem – mellow Morning Dew into tight Playing In The Band, Uncle John’s Band and a soaring Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean SBD source that reproduces the famed Wall‑of‑Sound era ambience with clarity; only a brief gap before “Fly Away” and the missing first set detract. Musically the second set shines – Morning Dew opens the set, followed by seamless transitions into Playing In The Band (twice), Uncle John’s Band, He’s Gone and an inspired Wharf Rat, highlighted by Garcia’s soaring guitar and Kreutzmann’s jazzy drumming.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars praising both performance and sound quality; only minor recording gaps and the absent first set keep it from a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced SBD capture with crisp instrument separation. Minor issues: ~10‑20 s gap before “Fly Away” and the first set is missing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows naturally with mellow opening, tight transitions (Dew → Playing In The Band → UJB), and a high‑energy climax ending in Wharf Rat.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work described as “unbelievable” with perfect tone; his vocal on Wharf Rat noted as nice.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass (“Phil Zone”) is mentioned as prominent and high in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann praised for a jazzy groove on “Mississippi Half‑Step” that stands out compared to later performances.
